name: Range ladder, Mavic 3 by distance band
collection: JIOPs four-camera test, TST Ranch, 12 to 13 Nov 2026

questions.text: At which distance bands does each of the four cameras detect, confirm and identify a Mavic 3 on the fly-area axis, and with what probability per bin?
questions.note: Response: detection outcome per bin, per camera, per run (possible, confirmed, identified, none; FOV-limited flag). Vary: distance band (5 levels), camera configuration (4). Hold: altitude 40 m AGL, speed 5 m/s, aspect head-on, 30 s per band. Record: sun, sky background, wind, visibility. Replicates: 3 runs minimum (Appendix C.2). Target-absent interval: 120 s before launch, every run.

1.3.source: Appendix B example value, 80 deg horizontal; confirm against the purchased model; tilt 10 deg up; sensor 2560 x 1920 (4:3) so vertical FOV 64.4 deg; reach 203 m at 3 px on a 0.4 m target

Derived: 2x optical zoom of the 80 deg lens, 2 atan(tan 40 deg / 2); replace with the lens spec at the zoom step set; tilt 8 deg up; sensor 2560 x 1920 (4:3) so vertical FOV 34.9 deg; reach 407 m at 3 px on a 0.4 m target

Spec value at 5x (a true 5x of the 80 deg lens gives 19.0 deg); replace with the lens spec at the zoom step set; tilt 6 deg up; sensor 2560 x 1920 (4:3) so vertical FOV 13.2 deg; reach 500 m at 3 px on a 0.4 m target

report.notes: Run order: ladder first; it establishes the distance bins for the other profiles. Three replicate runs under the same conditions; add a fourth if two bins disagree between runs. Hover 30 s at 450, 350, 250, 150 and 75 m from the camera line, 40 m AGL, 5 m/s between bands, head-on aspect. Each hover gives every camera one 30 s observation interval per bin. Review each camera independently (plan section 7, step 6) and mark possible, confirmed and identified per bin; compute ground and slant range from the GCS log at each event. Before the first run: synchronize the PC, camera and telemetry clocks, record the offset with a visible time-marked event, and keep the correction (plan section 7, step 3). Safety: every path stays inside the UAS Fly Area; no path points at the camera site or at GCS-1. The One-way attack aim point sits 60 m short of the cameras. Site datum: the profile origin is the centre of the UAS Fly Area file (lat 35.289972, lon -79.385599, WGS84). Ground elevation 150 m is a planning value; survey it.

collection: JIOPs four-camera test, TST Ranch, 12 to 13 Nov 2026

name: Swarm, seven aircraft with crossings
collection: JIOPs four-camera test, TST Ranch, 12 to 13 Nov 2026

questions.text: With seven aircraft in the fly area at once, which aircraft does each camera detect, when and where, which observations are missed or false, and how often is an observation associated with the wrong aircraft?
questions.note: Response per camera per aircraft: detection events with ground and slant range; missed observations; false detections; wrong associations. Vary: spacing (crossing pair at 5 m vertical, close pair at 16 m), speed (6 to 16 m/s), altitude (20 to 60 m AGL). Hold: camera settings as the ladder baseline. Record: sun, background, wind. Replicates: 2 runs minimum. Target-absent interval: 120 s before launch. Multi-aircraft association extends the single-aircraft method of the plan.

report.notes: Last in the order. Two replicate runs. Aircraft from the inventory: 2 DJI Mavic 3 (T1, T2) and 5 Rotor Riot Tanq 5 inch (T3 to T7). name: Controlled repeat, optical zoom 1x against 5x
collection: JIOPs four-camera test, TST Ranch, 12 to 13 Nov 2026

questions.text: Does optical zoom (1x against 5x) on the varifocal cameras change the first-cue, confirmed and identified ranges for the same Mavic 3 approach, and by how much against the run-to-run variation?
questions.note: Response: first possible, confirmed and identified range per camera per run; the difference between levels and the spread within a level. Vary: optical zoom on CAM-3 and CAM-4 (1x, 5x). Hold: CAM-1 and CAM-2 at 80 deg, 40 m AGL, 8 m/s, head-on, same path. Record: sun, sky background, wind. Replicates: 3 runs per level, levels alternated. Target-absent interval: 120 s before launch. A second factor, defined background condition, can replace zoom with the same profile.
